author: Aerosmith
body:
Hello! Aerosmith here. Today I have made a DTM, two monuments per team. This is a Spider themed map with Cave Spiders vs Spiders, and a center island. I created this map for my master, xArcturus. I feel it is done now, but if anyone has any suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment down below! Credits to alexanderjoe10 for hosting the server, and here's the good stuff:
Album: http://imgur.com/a/hY1X8
YML: http://pastebin.com/gjXhU5cs
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/988btr7shdcof35/Aerosmith2.zip
P.S, xArcturus doesn't make me flat, he was never flat in the first place.
